items.title: What Does Abbott Laboratories (ABT) FDA Clearance Mean For Its Diabetes Device Push?
items.summary: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT) received FDA De Novo authorization for its Libre Duo 10 Day, described as the first dual glucose ketone monitoring wearable for U.S. patients. The Libre Duo 10 Day is cleared for use in people with diabetes as young as age 2 and is intended to support real time tracking of both glucose and ketone levels.
